name: Alternating Jump Lunge
body: is caught in mid-air mid-way through a jump lunge, both feet off the floor, front knee bent over the front ankle and the back knee bent low beneath her hip, torso upright, hands on hips. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Alternating Reverse Lunge
body: steps one leg straight back behind her into a reverse lunge, the back knee lowered close to the floor beneath her hip, the front shin vertical with the knee stacked over the ankle, torso tall, hands on hips. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
body: sits with her upper back and shoulder blades braced against a padded bench and her hips lifted so her torso and thighs form one straight line, one foot planted flat taking her weight while the other heel rests lightly on the floor for balance, chin tucked. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Back Extension
body: lies face down over a horizontal back-extension bench with her hips on the pad and her ankles hooked under the rollers behind her, lifting her chest and shoulders up so her spine extends in a long gentle arch, fingertips light behind her head. Erectors and glutes softly washed in sage green.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
body: kneels facing a long resistance band anchored high above her, gripping both ends with her arms reaching up and out, pulling them down toward shoulder height with her elbows driving down beside her ribs and her chest lifted. Lats softly washed in sage green.

name: Bear Crawl
body: is on hands and knees with her knees hovering just above the floor, hips level and back flat like a table, one arm and the opposite leg reaching forward through the crawl, head in line with her spine. Shoulders and abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Bicycle Crunch
body: lies on her back with her fingertips light behind her head, her shoulder blades lifted off the floor, one knee drawn in toward her chest while the other leg extends long and low, twisting so the opposite elbow reaches toward that bent knee. Obliques softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Box Jump
body: stands facing a sturdy wooden plyo box, crouched and loaded with her hips pushed back, knees bent and arms swung behind her, eyes up and ready to jump onto the box. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Box Jump to Step Down
body: stands on top of a sturdy wooden plyo box on one flat foot, the other leg stepping down and back toward the floor with the knee bent, arms out lightly for balance. Quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Box Step Over
body: stands tall on top of a sturdy wooden plyo box on one flat foot, the other leg lifted with knee bent and foot off the box, arms relaxed at her sides. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Box Step Over with Knee Drive
body: balances on top of a sturdy wooden plyo box on one flat foot, driving the opposite knee up to hip height with the foot lifted and toes down, arms swinging in opposition. Quadriceps and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Bridge Pulse
body: lies on her back with her knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, hips lifted so her body runs in one straight line from knees to shoulders, holding just below the top of the movement, arms long at her sides. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Broad Jump
body: is caught in mid-air during a two-footed broad jump, knees bent and feet together, arms swept back behind her and torso leaning slightly forward, ready to land. Glutes and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Broad Jump Burpee
body: is in the low push-up position of a burpee with her hands planted under her shoulders and her chest close to the floor, legs extended straight back behind her, hips level. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Broad Jump to Sprint
body: has just landed from a two-footed jump and is driving straight into a sprint stride, one knee high in front and the opposite leg extended back, arms pumping hard. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Burpee
body: is in the low crouched landing of a burpee with both hands flat on the floor in front of her feet, hips low and head up looking forward. Quadriceps and chest softly washed in terracotta.

name: Burpee Box Jump Over
body: is suspended over a sturdy wooden plyo box with both hands planted on top of it and her knees tucked up toward her chest, feet clear of the floor. Abdominals and chest softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Burpee to Box Jump
body: is at the bottom of a burpee with both hands on the floor under her shoulders and one foot already swinging forward to plant, a sturdy wooden plyo box waiting in front of her. Quadriceps and chest softly washed in terracotta.

name: Burpee to Pull Up
body: hangs from a high bar with both hands gripping it overhand and slightly wider than her shoulders, elbows bent and pulling her chin up toward the bar, knees bent and crossed behind her. Lats and biceps softly washed in sage green.

name: Burpee to Tuck Jump
body: is airborne at the top of a tuck jump with both knees drawn up toward her chest and both arms reaching forward, feet clear of the floor. Abdominals and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Butt Kick
body: jogs in place with one heel flicked up behind her toward her glute and the other foot flat beneath her, arms bent at her sides and driving in opposition. Hamstrings softly washed in sage green.

name: Cossack Squat
body: sinks into a deep wide-stance side squat with her weight over one deeply bent knee, the other leg straight out to the side with the foot flat and toes turned up, torso upright with hands together at her chest. Adductors and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Criss Cross
body: lies on her back with her fingertips light behind her head, shoulder blades lifted and both legs raised with knees bent, twisting her ribcage so one elbow crosses toward the opposite knee. Obliques softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Dumbbell Clean
body: stands with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand, hips hinged back and dumbbells hanging at her shins, caught at the top of the pull with elbows bent and weights rising to her shoulders. Glutes and trapezius softly washed in terracotta.

name: Dumbbell Clean to Press
body: stands tall with a dumbbell in each hand at her shoulders, elbows under her wrists, pressing both weights straight overhead until her arms are long, feet hip-width apart. Shoulders and glutes softly washed in sage green.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
body: lies on her back on the floor with her knees bent and feet flat, holding a dumbbell in each hand above her chest with elbows bent to about ninety degrees and her upper arms resting lightly on the floor. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
body: sits with her upper back braced against a padded bench and a dumbbell resting across the crease of her hips, feet flat and hips lifted so her torso and thighs form one straight line, chin tucked. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Dumbbell Punch
body: stands in a small fighting stance holding a light dumbbell in each hand at chest height, one arm extended straight forward in a punch and the other drawn back with elbow bent. Shoulders and core softly washed in sage green.

name: Dumbbell Row
body: hinges forward with one hand braced on a padded bench, back flat and parallel to the floor, holding a dumbbell in her free hand and pulling it up to her ribs with the elbow driving back past her torso. Lats softly washed in sage green.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
body: stands with feet hip-width apart holding one dumbbell in a single hand, driving it overhead in one long line with her arm extended and her other arm out for balance, knees softly bent. Shoulders and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Dumbbell Snatch to Thruster
body: stands in a quarter squat with a dumbbell in each hand at her shoulders, elbows high, driving the weights overhead as she extends her legs, arms locking out above her head. Shoulders and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Dumbbell Squat to Press
body: stands with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at her shoulders, in a quarter squat with hips back, about to drive the weights overhead as she stands. Quadriceps and shoulders softly washed in terracotta.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
body: stands with feet shoulder-width apart in a quarter squat holding a dumbbell in each hand at her shoulders with elbows high, torso upright and core braced. Quadriceps and shoulders softly washed in terracotta.

name: Explosive Push Up
body: is in the top of a push-up with her body in one straight line from head to heels and both hands pressing hard into the floor so her palms are just leaving the ground, legs extended behind her. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Farmers Carry
body: walks forward carrying a heavy dumbbell in each hand at her sides, arms long, shoulders pulled back and down, torso upright and ribs stacked over her hips. Forearms and abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Fast Feet
body: stands in a low athletic stance with knees bent and hips back, feet close together and both on the balls of her feet, arms bent at her sides ready to move. Quadriceps and calves softly washed in terracotta.

name: Fast Feet Sprint in Place
body: runs on the spot in a low athletic stance with knees bent, one foot lifted on the ball of the foot and the other pushing off the floor, arms driving bent at her sides. Quadriceps and calves softly washed in terracotta.

name: Flutter Kick
body: lies on her back with both legs extended long and lifted a hand's width off the floor, one leg slightly higher than the other mid-flutter, hands pressed flat under her hips, lower back held to the floor. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Frog Pump
body: lies on her back with the soles of her feet together and knees dropped open to the sides, hips lifted off the floor in a bridge with her heels drawn in close, arms long at her sides. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Half Kneeling Single Arm Press
body: kneels on one knee with the other foot planted flat in front, torso upright and core braced, pressing one dumbbell straight overhead with a long arm while the other hand rests on her hip. Shoulders softly washed in sage green.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
body: hangs from a high bar with both hands gripping it overhand, arms long and shoulders active, drawing both knees up toward her chest with a rounded lower back and legs together. Abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Heel Tap
body: lies on her back with her knees bent and feet lifted off the floor at ninety degrees, one heel lowering toward the floor while the other knee stays stacked over her hip, lower back held down, arms long at her sides. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: High Knee
body: runs on the spot with one knee driven up to hip height and the opposite foot pushing off the floor, torso tall and arms bent, driving in opposition. Hip flexors and quadriceps softly washed in terracotta.

name: Hollow Body Rock
body: balances on her lower back in a hollow body shape with her shoulder blades and both legs lifted off the floor, arms long overhead, body curved like a shallow banana, caught mid-rock. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Ice Skater
body: balances on one bent leg with the other leg swept behind and across her body, foot off the floor, torso hinged slightly forward and arms out to the sides like a speed skater gliding. Glutes and abductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Incline Push Up
body: holds a push-up with both hands planted on a raised stable bench in front of her, body in one straight line from head to heels, arms extended, feet on the floor behind. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Inner Thigh Lift
body: lies on her side propped on one forearm with her top foot placed flat on the floor in front of her and her bottom leg straight, lifting the bottom leg up toward the ceiling with the toes turned out. Adductors softly washed in sage green.

name: Jump Squat
body: is airborne at the top of a jump squat with both feet clear of the floor and legs nearly straight, knees soft and arms swept up in front of her, torso upright. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Jumping Jack
body: is airborne in a jumping jack with her feet wide apart and both arms raised overhead in a wide V, body straight and facing forward. Shoulders and calves softly washed in terracotta.
